verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API for retrieving account data such as clients, session history and address book names. Its first-party open-source Python module can export session data to CSV, an open format. That covers only part of the story: there is no documented one-step export of all account data, and no account-closure path. The CLI `--remove` parameter only uninstalls the client and does not count toward leaving the service. Missing for 10: complete export of all user data (address book contents, settings, users/roles), a documented self-serve bulk-export feature, an account deletion/offboarding flow, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data from the [my.anydesk I](http://my.anydesk.com/login) management console.
Export session data (to terminal or CSV)
You can use the API to integrate AnyDesk data with third-party systems, for example, to automate billing or collect session logs.
